creators.name: Lynette Wallworth
creators.bio: Australian artist working with immersive film and installation, often in collaboration with Indigenous communities (Collisions, Awavena).
creators.why: Uses VR to share an Indigenous way of seeing the forest as alive.
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚艺术家，创作沉浸式影片与装置，常与原住民社群合作（《Collisions》《Awavena》）。
creators.why_zh: 用 VR 分享一种把森林视为有生命存在的原住民观看方式。

creators.name: Deniz Tortum
creators.bio: Turkish filmmaker and researcher (MIT Open Documentary Lab alumnus) working across documentary, VR and installation.
creators.why: His VR film asks whether a person can become a forest or a stone.
creators.bio_zh: 土耳其电影人与研究者（MIT 开放纪录片实验室校友），创作横跨纪录片、VR 与装置。
creators.why_zh: 他的 VR 影片追问：人能否成为一片森林或一块石头。

creators.name: Bartabas
creators.bio: French director and founder of Théâtre équestre Zingaro, known for performances in which horses are the protagonists.
creators.why: Brought his horse-centred theatre into VR, where the viewer gradually becomes the horse.
creators.role_zh: 马术剧场导演（Zingaro 剧团）
creators.bio_zh: 法国导演，Zingaro 马术剧团创始人，以马为主角的演出闻名。
creators.why_zh: 把以马为中心的剧场带进 VR，让观众逐渐成为马。

creators.name: Pierre Zandrowicz
creators.bio: French director and co-founder of the immersive studio Atlas V.
creators.why: Co-directed Ex Anima, a VR work built around the breath and presence of horses.
creators.bio_zh: 法国导演，沉浸式工作室 Atlas V 联合创始人。
creators.why_zh: 联合执导《Ex Anima》，一部围绕马的呼吸与存在展开的 VR 作品。

creators.name: Hsin-Chien Huang
creators.bio: Taiwanese new-media artist, long-time collaborator of Laurie Anderson; his VR works (Samsara, The Starry Sand Beach) have won at Venice.
creators.why: Designs VR around embodied cognition: you are moved through the bodies of other beings.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家与 VR 导演
creators.bio_zh: 台湾新媒体艺术家黄心健，长期与 Laurie Anderson 合作；其 VR 作品（《轮回》《星砂之海》）多次在威尼斯获奖。
creators.why_zh: 以具身认知设计 VR：让你依次进入其他生命的身体。

creators.name: Nina Barbier
creators.bio: French director of science documentaries, including work with the Muséum national d'Histoire naturelle.
creators.why: Co-directed a VR tale told at the scale of a single-celled foraminifera.
creators.bio_zh: 法国科学纪录片导演，曾与法国国家自然历史博物馆合作。
creators.why_zh: 联合执导一部以单细胞有孔虫尺度讲述的 VR 童话。

creators.name: Lena Thiele
creators.bio: German director of interactive documentaries; co-directed Myriad with Sebastian Baurmann and Dirk Hoffmann for the Interactive Media Foundation.
creators.why: Built a VR journey along the migration routes of three animals from scientific tracking data.
creators.bio_zh: 德国互动纪录片导演；与 Sebastian Baurmann、Dirk Hoffmann 为 Interactive Media Foundation 联合执导《Myriad》。
creators.why_zh: 根据科学追踪数据，沿三种动物的迁徙路线打造 VR 旅程。

creators.name: Alchemy Immersive
creators.bio: British studio producing VR and mixed-reality natural history series with David Attenborough and Atlantic Productions (Micro Monsters, Kingdom of Plants).
creators.why: Shifts the viewer to the scale and time of insects and plants.
creators.bio_zh: 英国工作室，与 David Attenborough 及 Atlantic Productions 合作制作 VR 与混合现实自然史系列（《Micro Monsters》《Kingdom of Plants》）。
creators.why_zh: 把观众带到昆虫与植物的尺度和时间里。

creators.name: Visiontrick Media
creators.bio: Swedish independent studio (director Rui Guerreiro) behind the VR games Pan-Pan and Mare.
creators.why: Made a VR game where you are an artificial bird guiding a companion.
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典独立工作室（导演 Rui Guerreiro），开发了 VR 游戏《Pan-Pan》与《Mare》。
creators.why_zh: 做了一款让你化身人造飞鸟、护送同伴的 VR 游戏。

creators.name: ScanLAB Projects
creators.bio: London studio using LiDAR scanning for architecture, film and art.
creators.why: Re-times landscapes so that growth and erosion become visible.
creators.role_zh: 三维扫描工作室（Matthew Shaw 与 William Trossell）
creators.bio_zh: 以激光雷达扫描服务建筑、电影与艺术的伦敦工作室。
creators.why_zh: 重新调整风景的时间，让生长与侵蚀变得可见。

creators.name: Temsüyanger Longkumer
creators.bio: Naga-born artist working between painting, sculpture and VR; his VR piece home was filmed with a bee colony in Gaili, Nagaland.
creators.why: Makes the beehive a model of humanity's shared home.
creators.bio_zh: 出生于那加兰的艺术家，创作横跨绘画、雕塑与 VR；VR 作品《home》与那加兰 Gaili 的一个蜂群一起拍摄。
creators.why_zh: 把蜂巢当作人类共同家园的模型。

creators.name: Adriaan Lokman
creators.bio: Dutch animation director known for abstract films of air and turbulence (Barcode, Flow).
creators.why: Made a VR installation built entirely from wind, scent and warm air.
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰动画导演，以关于空气与湍流的抽象影片闻名（《Barcode》《Flow》）。
creators.why_zh: 做了一个完全由风、气味与暖气流构成的 VR 装置。

creators.name: Maya Mouawad
creators.bio: Franco-Lebanese designer of interactive installations, co-author of Peupler with composer Cyril Laurier.
creators.why: Designed an installation to see and feel a city from a tree's point of view.
creators.bio_zh: 法国黎巴嫩裔互动装置设计师，与作曲家 Cyril Laurier 合作《Peupler》。
creators.why_zh: 设计了一个从树的视角看见并感受城市的装置。

creators.name: Cyril Laurier
creators.bio: French-Spanish composer and data artist working with generative sound and AI.
creators.why: Co-created Peupler, where visitors' presence feeds a virtual tree.
creators.bio_zh: 法国西班牙裔作曲家与数据艺术家，从事生成声音与 AI 创作。
creators.why_zh: 联合创作《Peupler》，访客的在场为一棵虚拟树提供养分。

creators.name: Joren Vandenbroucke
creators.bio: Belgian director at Animal Tank, known for comic VR and animation.
creators.why: Made a VR comedy in which you are a potted geranium.
creators.role_zh: 动画与 VR 导演（Animal Tank）
creators.bio_zh: 比利时 Animal Tank 工作室导演，以喜剧 VR 与动画见长。
creators.why_zh: 做了一部让你成为一盆天竺葵的 VR 喜剧。

creators.name: Within
creators.bio: Studio founded by Chris Milk and Aaron Koblin, early producer of cinematic and social VR.
creators.why: Life of Us moves two people through a chain of evolving bodies.
creators.role_zh: VR 工作室（Chris Milk 与 Aaron Koblin）
creators.bio_zh: 由 Chris Milk 与 Aaron Koblin 创立的工作室，电影化与社交 VR 的早期制作者。
creators.why_zh: 《Life of Us》让两个人依次穿过不断进化的身体。

creators.name: Chris Milk
creators.bio: American director and co-founder of Within, known for early interactive installations and VR.
creators.why: The Treachery of Sanctuary turns visitors' shadows into birds that fly away.
creators.bio_zh: 美国导演，Within 联合创始人，以早期互动装置与 VR 闻名。
creators.why_zh: 《The Treachery of Sanctuary》把观众的影子变成飞走的鸟。

creators.name: Leanne Allison
creators.bio: Canadian wildlife filmmaker who co-directed the NFB interactive documentary Bear 71.
creators.why: Told the life of a grizzly through the trail cameras that watched her.
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大野生动物电影人，联合执导加拿大国家电影局互动纪录片《Bear 71》。
creators.why_zh: 借监视她的红外相机讲述一头灰熊的一生。

creators.name: Jeremy Mendes
creators.bio: Canadian interactive filmmaker, co-director of Bear 71 for the National Film Board of Canada.
creators.why: Designed the surveillance-map interface through which users follow a bear.
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大互动电影人，为加拿大国家电影局联合执导《Bear 71》。
creators.why_zh: 设计了用户借以追随一头熊的监控地图界面。

creators.name: Diego Galafassi
creators.bio: Brazilian-born artist and researcher (Stockholm Resilience Centre) working with immersive media and climate.
creators.why: Made breath visible as air that travels between bodies and around the planet.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家与可持续性研究者
creators.bio_zh: 巴西裔艺术家与研究者（斯德哥尔摩韧性中心），以沉浸式媒体关注气候。
creators.why_zh: 把呼吸显形为在身体之间、环绕地球流动的空气。

creators.name: Bianca Kennedy
creators.bio: German artist who works with The Swan Collective on hand-sculpted, photogrammetry-captured VR.
creators.why: Animalia Sum makes you a bug, then a bug farmer, in a future of insect protein.
creators.bio_zh: 德国艺术家，与 The Swan Collective 合作，用手工雕塑加摄影测量制作 VR。
creators.why_zh: 《Animalia Sum》在昆虫蛋白的未来里先让你成为虫，再成为养虫人。

creators.name: The Swan Collective
creators.bio: Collective founded by Felix Kraus making VR and installation art.
creators.why: Co-created Animalia Sum with Bianca Kennedy.
creators.bio_zh: 由 Felix Kraus 创立的 VR 与装置艺术团体。
creators.why_zh: 与 Bianca Kennedy 共同创作《Animalia Sum》。

creators.name: Arnaud Colinart
creators.bio: French producer and co-founder of Atlas V; co-directed the VR adaptation of Notes on Blindness.
creators.why: Helped turn a blind man's audio diary into a VR world made of sound.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式制片人与导演（Atlas V）
creators.bio_zh: 法国制片人、Atlas V 联合创始人；联合执导《Notes on Blindness》VR 版。
creators.why_zh: 参与把一位盲人的录音日记变成由声音构成的 VR 世界。

creators.name: Amaury La Burthe
creators.bio: French sound designer, founder of AudioGaming, co-director of Notes on Blindness: Into Darkness.
creators.why: Designed binaural worlds that appear only where sound falls.
creators.role_zh: 声音设计师与 VR 导演（AudioGaming）
creators.bio_zh: 法国声音设计师，AudioGaming 创始人，《Notes on Blindness: Into Darkness》联合导演。
creators.why_zh: 设计只在声音落下之处显现的双耳音频世界。

creators.name: Miri Chekhanovich
creators.bio: Israeli-Canadian visual artist; co-created Plastisapiens with Édith Jorisch (NFB and DPT).
creators.why: Uses embodiment to imagine bodies changed by plastic.
creators.bio_zh: 以色列裔加拿大视觉艺术家；与 Édith Jorisch 合作《Plastisapiens》（加拿大国家电影局与 DPT 出品）。
creators.why_zh: 以具身体验想象被塑料改变的身体。

creators.name: Édith Jorisch
creators.bio: Canadian filmmaker and visual artist, co-creator of Plastisapiens.
creators.why: Co-designed VR bodies that are part animal, part plastic.
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大电影人与视觉艺术家，《Plastisapiens》联合创作者。
creators.why_zh: 共同设计半动物、半塑料的 VR 身体。

creators.name: Adam May
creators.bio: British creator of stereo and location-based immersive work, maker of Critical Distance with Chris Campkin.
creators.why: Made orca echolocation visible as sound in space on HoloLens 2.
creators.bio_zh: 英国立体与场景式沉浸作品创作者，与 Chris Campkin 合作《Critical Distance》。
creators.why_zh: 在 HoloLens 2 上把虎鲸的回声定位显现为空间中的声音。

creators.name: Chris Campkin
creators.bio: Key collaborator on Critical Distance at Vision3.
creators.why: Co-created a mixed-reality encounter with the Southern Resident orcas.
creators.bio_zh: Vision3《Critical Distance》的主要合作者。
creators.why_zh: 共同创作与南方定居虎鲸相遇的混合现实体验。

creators.name: Jonah King
creators.bio: American artist working in VR, film and sculpture; assistant professor at Stevens Institute of Technology.
creators.why: Honey Fungus stages intimacy with a sentient fungal network.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，创作 VR、影像与雕塑；Stevens 理工学院助理教授。
creators.why_zh: 《Honey Fungus》上演人与有感知的真菌网络之间的亲密。

creators.name: Holition
creators.bio: London studio making interactive and immersive digital installations.
creators.why: Took Barbican visitors down to the scale of soil organisms.
creators.bio_zh: 制作互动与沉浸式数字装置的伦敦工作室。
creators.why_zh: 把巴比肯的观众带到土壤生物的尺度。

creators.name: George Monbiot
creators.bio: British journalist and author of Feral and Regenesis.
creators.why: Argued that soil should be revered like a coral reef; his research shaped The World Beneath Our Feet.
creators.bio_zh: 英国记者，著有《Feral》与《Regenesis》。
creators.why_zh: 主张土壤应像珊瑚礁一样被珍视；其研究塑造了《The World Beneath Our Feet》。

creators.name: Victoria Vesna
creators.bio: Media artist and professor who directs the UCLA Art|Sci Center, working on nanotechnology, sound and ecology.
creators.why: Noise Aquarium puts visitors among magnified plankton under noise pollution.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家（UCLA 艺术科学中心）
creators.bio_zh: 媒体艺术家与教授，领导 UCLA 艺术科学中心，关注纳米技术、声音与生态。
creators.why_zh: 《Noise Aquarium》把观众放进噪声污染下被放大的浮游生物之间。

creators.name: Ant Farm
creators.bio: Radical architecture collective (Chip Lord, Doug Michels, Curtis Schreier and others), known for Cadillac Ranch and Media Burn.
creators.why: Dolphin Embassy is an early design for communication across species.
creators.bio_zh: 激进建筑团体（Chip Lord、Doug Michels、Curtis Schreier 等），以《Cadillac Ranch》《Media Burn》闻名。
creators.why_zh: 《Dolphin Embassy》是早期的跨物种交流设计。

creators.name: Shimabuku
creators.bio: Japanese artist whose playful actions often involve animals, especially octopuses.
creators.why: Makes sculptures whose audience is octopuses.
creators.bio_zh: 日本艺术家，其轻松的行动作品常与动物尤其是章鱼有关。
creators.why_zh: 做以章鱼为观众的雕塑。

creators.name: Es Devlin
creators.bio: British artist known for large-scale sculptures and stage designs that combine light, text and sound.
creators.why: Forest of Us maps the branching of human lungs onto the branching of trees.
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，以结合光、文字与声音的大型雕塑和舞台设计闻名。
creators.why_zh: 《Forest of Us》把人肺的分支与树的分支对应起来。

creators.name: Wolfgang Buttress
creators.bio: British artist who made The Hive for the UK Pavilion at Expo Milano 2015 with physicist Martin Bencsik.
creators.why: Lets visitors hear and feel a live bee colony's vibrations through light, sound and bone conduction.
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，与物理学家 Martin Bencsik 为 2015 米兰世博会英国馆创作《The Hive》。
creators.why_zh: 让访客通过光、声音与骨传导听见并感受一个活蜂群的振动。

creators.name: Superflux
creators.role: Speculative design studio (Anab Jain & Jon Ardern)
creators.bio: Design studio making speculative futures and more-than-human installations.
creators.why: Refuge for Resurgence seats humans among fourteen other species at one table.
creators.role_zh: 思辨设计工作室（Anab Jain 与 Jon Ardern）
creators.bio_zh: 创作思辨未来与超越人类装置的设计工作室。
creators.why_zh: 《Refuge for Resurgence》让人类与另外十四个物种同桌而坐。

creators.name: Momoko Seto
creators.bio: Japanese-born, Paris-based filmmaker whose PLANET series films real micro-organisms, fungi and insects in macro time-lapse as alien worlds.
creators.why: Shifts the viewer to the scale and time of mould, fungi and tadpoles.
creators.bio_zh: 出生于日本、常居巴黎的电影人，其《PLANET》系列以微距延时拍摄真实的微生物、真菌与昆虫，把它们呈现为异星世界。
creators.why_zh: 把观众带到霉菌、真菌与蝌蚪的尺度与时间。

creators.name: Jörg Courtial
creators.bio: German director and co-founder of the digital studio Faber Courtial, known for VR and dome films on space and evolution.
creators.why: Genesis compresses Earth's 4.7 billion years into one day around the viewer.
creators.bio_zh: 德国导演，数字工作室 Faber Courtial 联合创始人，以关于太空与进化的 VR 与球幕影片闻名。
creators.why_zh: 《Genesis》把地球 47 亿年压缩成观众身边的一天。

creators.name: Luma Octo
creators.bio: German studio of filmmakers Max Sacker and Arite Szadkowski making interactive, musical immersive cinema.
creators.why: Octopocalypse stages first contact with an octopus intelligence through rhythm and touch.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式工作室（Max Sacker 与 Arite Szadkowski）
creators.bio_zh: 德国电影人 Max Sacker 与 Arite Szadkowski 的工作室，创作互动、音乐化的沉浸式影像。
creators.why_zh: 《Octopocalypse》以节奏与触觉上演与章鱼智能的第一次接触。

creators.name: Steye Hallema
creators.role: Artist, founder of The Smartphone Orchestra
creators.bio: Dutch artist making collective experiences on audiences' own phones (The Smartphone Orchestra, The Imaginary Friend).
creators.why: Turns a crowd into the voice of a lagoon or river claiming rights of nature.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家，The Smartphone Orchestra 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰艺术家，用观众自己的手机创作集体体验（The Smartphone Orchestra、《The Imaginary Friend》）。
creators.why_zh: 把人群变成争取自然权利的潟湖或河流的声音。

creators.name: Sarah Silverblatt-Buser
creators.bio: American choreographer and filmmaker making movement-based VR and dance films.
creators.why: Collective Body turns each dancer's movement signature into an elemental avatar.
creators.role_zh: 编舞与 XR 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 美国编舞与电影人，创作以动作为基础的 VR 与舞蹈影像。
creators.why_zh: 《Collective Body》把每位舞者的动作特征变成一种元素化身。

creators.name: Institute of Digital Fashion
creators.role: Digital fashion collective (Leanne Elliott Young & Catty Tay)
creators.bio: London collective making gender-nonconforming avatars, 3D couture and AR/VR experiences.
creators.why: Queer Ecology maps visitors' bodies onto plant beings that grow, merge and decay.
creators.role_zh: 数字时尚团体（Leanne Elliott Young 与 Catty Tay）
creators.bio_zh: 伦敦团体，创作性别非常规化身、三维高定与 AR/VR 体验。
creators.why_zh: 《Queer Ecology》把访客的身体映射成会生长、融合与衰败的植物存在。

creators.name: Brigitte Baptiste
creators.bio: Colombian biologist, former director of the Humboldt Institute and rector of Universidad EAN, known for queer ecology.
creators.why: Her claim that 'there is nothing more queer than nature' shaped the Barbican piece.
creators.role_zh: 生物学家与酷儿生态学者
creators.bio_zh: 哥伦比亚生物学家，曾任洪堡研究所所长、EAN 大学校长，以酷儿生态学著称。
creators.why_zh: 她“没有什么比自然更酷儿”的观点塑造了巴比肯的这件作品。

works.title: Awavena
works.description: A VR documentary made with the Yawanawa of the Amazon and their first woman shaman, Hushahu; the forest is shown as it appears in a medicine vision, with plants and beings glowing with life.
works.description_zh: 与亚马孙 Yawanawa 部族及其首位女萨满 Hushahu 共同完成的 VR 纪录片；森林以药物异象中的样子出现，植物与生灵都在发光。
works.idea_en: The forest seen as alive: VR stands in for a medicine vision that lets outsiders glimpse how the Yawanawa perceive plants and spirits.
works.idea_zh: 把森林看作有生命的存在：VR 代替药物异象，让外来者瞥见 Yawanawa 人如何感知植物与灵。
works.method: 360° live action shot in the Amazon combined with real-time rendered particle visions of the forest (VR headset).
works.method_zh: 在亚马孙拍摄的 360° 实景结合实时渲染的森林粒子异象（VR 头显）。

works.title: Selyatağı (Floodplain)
works.description: A VR film in which a search party lost in a forest slated for construction falls under the spell of an old tree, and the humans slowly merge with the forest.
works.description_zh: VR 影片：在一片即将被开发的森林里，搜救队迷失方向，被一棵老树的咒语笼罩，人类慢慢融入森林。
works.idea_en: Asks whether we can become a forest, a stone or a multitude of organisms when we can no longer be what we were.
works.idea_zh: 追问：当我们无法再是原来的自己时，能否成为一片森林、一块石头，或众多生物的集合。
works.method: 360° volumetric and photogrammetric forest scenes built on the world of the feature film Yuva (Emre Yeksan).
works.method_zh: 以体积捕捉与摄影测量建构的 360° 森林场景，延伸自剧情片《Yuva》（Emre Yeksan）的世界。

works.title: Ex Anima
works.description: Horses emerge from the dark, breathing and dancing on sand; as the piece unfolds the viewer moves with them until they increasingly become the horse.
works.description_zh: 马从黑暗中出现，在沙地上呼吸、起舞；随着作品推进，观众与它们一同移动，逐渐成为马。
works.idea_en: Becoming a horse through breath and rhythm rather than story: an ode to the breathing of animals.
works.idea_zh: 不靠故事，而是通过呼吸与节奏成为马：一首献给动物呼吸的颂歌。
works.method: VR film built from Théâtre Zingaro's equestrian performance, shot with stereoscopic capture of the horses (likely volumetric/CG hybrid).
works.method_zh: 以 Zingaro 马术剧团的演出为基础的 VR 影片，对马进行立体拍摄（很可能结合体积捕捉与 CG）。

works.title: Samsara
works.description: After humans destroy the Earth and re-engineer their DNA to survive in space, the participant returns to Earth in another era as a different life form, then passes through other beings' bodies in a cycle of rebirth.
works.description_zh: 人类毁掉地球、改造 DNA 流亡太空后，参与者在另一个时代以另一种生命形态回到地球，并在轮回中穿过其他生命的身体。
works.idea_en: Reincarnation as embodied cognition: each rebirth gives you a new body and a new perspective on the same planet.
works.idea_zh: 以轮回演绎具身认知：每一次重生都给你一具新身体、一种看同一颗星球的新视角。
works.method: Free-roaming VR with full-body avatars that change species across chapters (HTC Vive / Quest).
works.method_zh: 可自由走动的 VR，全身化身在各章节之间变换物种（HTC Vive / Quest）。

works.title: Myriad. Where We Connect
works.description: A VR journey along the real migration routes of a Northern Bald Ibis, an Arctic fox and a green sea turtle, following wind and ocean currents across a world made of carbon.
works.description_zh: 沿着北方秃鹮、北极狐与绿海龟真实迁徙路线展开的 VR 旅程，随风与洋流穿越一个由碳构成的世界。
works.idea_en: Travelling as a migrating animal makes the planet legible as currents, routes and distances rather than places.
works.idea_zh: 以迁徙动物的方式旅行，地球变成可读的洋流、路线与距离，而不是地点。
works.method: Real-time VR and 360° versions driven by scientific GPS tracking data of the three species.
works.method_zh: 实时 VR 与 360° 版本，由三种动物的科学 GPS 追踪数据驱动。

works.title: La plage de sable étoilé (The Starry Sand Beach)
works.description: A scientific fairy tale that shrinks the participant to the scale of Baculogypsina sphaerulata, the star-shaped foraminifera that make up the sand of East China Sea beaches, and travels 400 million years back through their history.
works.description_zh: 一则科学童话：把参与者缩小到星砂有孔虫（Baculogypsina sphaerulata）的尺度——东海海滩的星形沙粒——并回溯它们四亿年的历史。
works.idea_en: A game of scales: you become as small as a single-celled organism and as small again among the stars.
works.idea_zh: 一场尺度游戏：你小到单细胞生物那样，在群星之间又同样渺小。
works.method: Real-time VR (Vive/Quest) with scientific models from the Muséum national d'Histoire naturelle.
works.method_zh: 实时 VR（Vive/Quest），采用法国国家自然历史博物馆的科学模型。

works.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
works.description: A five-episode VR series that shrinks the viewer to insect size among scorpions, centipedes, aphids, weaver ants and trapdoor spiders, narrated by David Attenborough.
works.description_zh: 五集 VR 系列：把观众缩小到昆虫大小，置身蝎子、蜈蚣、蚜虫、织叶蚁与活板门蛛之间，由 David Attenborough 解说。
works.idea_en: Insect scale as the first step of becoming: the everyday ground turns into a vast, dangerous world.
works.idea_zh: 昆虫尺度是成为的第一步：平常的地面变成辽阔而危险的世界。
works.method: Stereoscopic macro live-action combined with CG, delivered on Meta Quest (director Elliot Graves).
works.method_zh: 立体微距实拍结合 CG，在 Meta Quest 上发布（导演 Elliot Graves）。

works.title: Mare
works.description: A VR puzzle game in which the player wakes up embodying an artificial bird and flies across strange landscapes to guide and protect a vulnerable AI companion.
works.description_zh: VR 解谜游戏：玩家醒来时化身一只人造鸟，飞越奇异的风景，引导并保护一个脆弱的 AI 同伴。
works.idea_en: The player never has hands: seeing, moving and helping all happen through a bird's gaze and flight.
works.idea_zh: 玩家没有手：看、移动与帮助全靠一只鸟的目光与飞行。
works.method: Gaze-directed flight on standalone VR (Oculus Quest); the bird is steered by head direction and perching points.
works.method_zh: 在一体机 VR（Oculus Quest）上以视线控制飞行；鸟随头部方向和栖停点移动。

works.title: Genesis
works.description: A VR journey through 4.7 billion years of Earth condensed onto a 24-hour clock: the young glowing planet, dark oceans, prehistoric jungles with giant insects, dinosaurs, mass extinctions and finally human ancestors.
works.description_zh: 一段 VR 旅程，把地球 47 亿年压缩到 24 小时的钟面上：年轻炽热的星球、黑暗的海洋、巨型昆虫的史前丛林、恐龙、大灭绝，最后是人类祖先。
works.idea_en: Taking the planet's time scale: humanity appears only in the final second of Earth's day.
works.idea_zh: 采用行星的时间尺度：人类只出现在地球这一天的最后一秒。
works.method: Real-time rendered VR (Vive / Quest) with an on-screen Earth clock and paleontologically informed CG environments.
works.method_zh: 实时渲染 VR（Vive / Quest），配有地球时钟，以古生物学资料为依据的 CG 场景。

works.title: Kingdom of Plants with David Attenborough
works.description: A three-part immersive series that places the viewer at the scale and pace of plants: sitting inside rare blooms, watching a sundew hunt and being consumed by fungi.
works.description_zh: 三集沉浸式系列：把观众放到植物的尺度与节奏中——坐进稀有花朵、看茅膏菜捕猎、被真菌吞没。
works.idea_en: Plant time made watchable: time-lapse at plant scale turns slow growth into drama you are inside.
works.idea_zh: 让植物时间变得可看：植物尺度的延时摄影把缓慢的生长变成你身处其中的戏剧。
works.method: Stereoscopic time-lapse and macro photography from the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, released on Meta Quest (director Iona McEwan).
works.method_zh: 在英国皇家植物园邱园拍摄的立体延时与微距影像，发布于 Meta Quest（导演 Iona McEwan）。

works.title: FRAMERATE: Pulse of the Earth
works.description: A multi-screen installation of LiDAR time-lapses of changing landscapes: a cliff eroding, a pumpkin growing, sand shifting and forests turning with the seasons.
works.description_zh: 多屏装置，展示激光雷达延时扫描下变化的风景：崖壁侵蚀、南瓜生长、沙丘移动、森林随季节变色。
works.idea_en: Seeing at the Earth's pace: geological and seasonal change compressed until land appears to breathe.
works.idea_zh: 以地球的速度观看：地质与季节的变化被压缩到大地仿佛在呼吸。
works.method: Repeated terrestrial LiDAR scans of the same sites over months, rendered as volumetric point-cloud time-lapses.
works.method_zh: 对同一地点进行数月重复的地面激光雷达扫描，渲染为体积点云延时影像。

works.title: home
works.description: A VR work filmed with a bee colony in Gaili, Nagaland, that takes the viewer inside a beehive as a model of humanity's relationship with its planet.
works.description_zh: 与那加兰 Gaili 一个蜂群共同拍摄的 VR 作品，带观众进入蜂巢，把它当作人类与地球关系的模型。
works.idea_en: Living inside the hive: the colony as a single organism whose choices mirror our own habitat-making.
works.idea_zh: 生活在蜂巢里：蜂群是一个整体生命，它的选择映照出人类的筑居方式。
works.method: Stereoscopic footage inside and around a living hive combined with animated sequences (VR headset).
works.method_zh: 在活体蜂巢内外拍摄的立体影像，结合动画段落（VR 头显）。

works.title: Flow
works.description: A VR installation made entirely of air: the visitor surrenders to wind currents that carry the story of a woman's night, felt as gusts, warmth, breath and scent.
works.description_zh: 完全由空气构成的 VR 装置：访客顺从风的流动，风讲述一位女性的一夜，以阵风、暖意、呼吸与气味被感受到。
works.idea_en: Becoming the wind: the story is told by air currents, not by characters, and the body reads it through skin.
works.idea_zh: 成为风：故事由气流而非角色讲述，身体用皮肤去读它。
works.method: Animated airflow simulation in VR synchronised with fans, heaters and scent diffusers around the seated visitor.
works.method_zh: VR 中的气流动画模拟，与围绕座位的风扇、加热器和气味扩散器同步。

works.title: Peupler
works.description: An interactive installation that lets visitors see and feel the city from the point of view of a tree, and feed that tree through their own presence.
works.description_zh: 互动装置：让访客从一棵树的视角看见并感受城市，并用自己的在场为这棵树提供养分。
works.idea_en: The tree as a witness of the city: taking its point of view makes cohabitation a question of who populates space.
works.idea_zh: 树是城市的见证者：采取它的视角，共居就成了“谁在占据空间”的问题。
works.method: Photogrammetric digital tree with generative sound, responding to visitors' movement via sensors (Fisheye Immersive).
works.method_zh: 摄影测量的数字树配合生成声音，通过传感器回应访客的移动（Fisheye Immersive）。

works.title: The Great Escape
works.description: An interactive VR comedy in which the viewer is the third of three bored geraniums on a lonely man's windowsill, rooted in place while they plot to see the world.
works.description_zh: 互动 VR 喜剧：观众是孤独男人窗台上三盆无聊天竺葵中的第三盆，被根固定在原地，却谋划着去看世界。
works.idea_en: Being rooted: embodying a potted plant turns immobility and a windowsill view into the whole of life.
works.idea_zh: 扎根的处境：成为一盆盆栽，不能移动与窗台的视野就是生活的全部。
works.method: Animated interactive VR with the participant fixed in the pot's position; interaction through gaze and limited hand gestures.
works.method_zh: 动画互动 VR，参与者被固定在花盆的位置；通过视线与有限的手势交互。

works.title: Octopocalypse
works.description: A three-person immersive installation after a meteor storm: participants face a fragile, prophetic alien octopus that tries to make contact through music, touch, rhythm and visions, and must choose whether to interrogate it or listen and earn its trust.
works.description_zh: 三人沉浸式装置，设定在流星风暴之后：参与者面对一只脆弱而具预言能力的外星章鱼，它试图通过音乐、触觉、节奏与幻象建立联系，参与者要决定是审问它，还是倾听并赢得信任。
works.idea_en: Meeting an octopus mind on its own terms: contact happens through rhythm and touch, and slowing down is the only way in.
works.idea_zh: 按章鱼心智自己的方式与它相遇：联系通过节奏与触觉发生，放慢速度是唯一的入口。
works.method: Multi-user installation combining immersive cinema, haptics and rhythm input; the group builds a music track from patterns sent by the octopus (generative AI used for prototyping).
works.method_zh: 多人装置，结合沉浸式影像、触觉与节奏输入；参与者用章鱼发出的模式共同搭建一段音乐（生成式 AI 用于原型制作）。

works.title: La Laguna Parla
works.description: A collective smartphone ritual for hundreds of participants that gives voice to the Venice lagoon as a living being, adapted from The Waterbodies Orchestra made with the Confluence of European Water Bodies.
works.description_zh: 面向数百名参与者的集体手机仪式，为作为生命存在的威尼斯潟湖发声，改编自与“欧洲水体汇流”合作的《The Waterbodies Orchestra》。
works.idea_en: Speaking as the lagoon: a crowd's phones become one voice for a body of water that claims legal personhood.
works.idea_zh: 以潟湖的身份说话：人群的手机汇成一种声音，为争取法律人格的水体发声。
works.method: Synchronised browser-based audio and light cues on participants' own smartphones, conducted live (The Smartphone Orchestra).
works.method_zh: 在参与者自己的手机上同步播放基于浏览器的声音与灯光提示，现场指挥（The Smartphone Orchestra）。

works.title: Collective Body
works.description: A multi-user VR dance experience set in a New Mexican storm: an algorithm analyses how each participant moves and assigns them one of sixteen avatars, each a natural element (earth, air, water or fire) with its own musical theme, before they meet and move with the others.
works.description_zh: 设定在新墨西哥暴风雨中的多人 VR 舞蹈体验：算法分析每位参与者的动作，为其分配十六种化身之一——每种都是一种自然元素（土、气、水或火）并配有音乐主题——随后与他人相遇、共同起舞。
works.idea_en: Your way of moving decides which element you become: embodiment as earth, air, water or fire rather than as a human figure.
works.idea_zh: 你的动作方式决定你成为哪种元素：以土、气、水或火而非人形来具身。
works.method: Full-body tracked social VR with movement classification into a 4×4 grid of elements and energy phases (solid, liquid, gas, plasma) driving avatars and music.
works.method_zh: 全身追踪的社交 VR，把动作分类到元素与能量相态（固、液、气、等离子）组成的 4×4 网格中，驱动化身与音乐。

works.title: Life of Us
works.description: A shared VR journey through evolution in which two participants embody a chain of creatures — single cell, fish, frog, pterodactyl, ape, human and beyond — with their voices modulated to match each body.
works.description_zh: 双人共享的 VR 进化之旅：两位参与者依次化身单细胞、鱼、青蛙、翼龙、猿、人类及更远的形态，声音也随每具身体变化。
works.idea_en: Evolution as a sequence of bodies you wear with a friend; seeing the other person's creature tells you what you have become.
works.idea_zh: 进化是一连串与朋友一起穿上的身体；看到对方的生物形态，你就知道自己变成了什么。
works.method: Real-time multi-user VR with tracked hands and real-time voice modulation for each creature.
works.method_zh: 实时多人 VR，手部追踪，并为每种生物实时变声。

works.title: Bear 71
works.description: An interactive documentary narrated by a female grizzly in Banff National Park, known only by her tag number, whose life is seen through trail cameras and a surveillance map; later adapted for VR.
works.description_zh: 由班夫国家公园一头只以标号为名的雌性灰熊讲述的互动纪录片，她的一生通过红外相机和监控地图呈现；后改编为 VR。
works.idea_en: The wild animal's view of being watched: the bear narrates while the user moves through the camera network that tracks her.
works.idea_zh: 野生动物被观看的视角：灰熊讲述，用户在追踪她的相机网络中移动。
works.method: WebGL map of Banff populated with trail-camera footage; the 2017 VR version (NFB with Jam3) turns the map into a walkable space.
works.method_zh: 以红外相机影像构成的班夫 WebGL 地图；2017 年 VR 版（加拿大国家电影局与 Jam3）把地图变成可走动的空间。

works.title: Breathe
works.description: A social mixed-reality piece that makes each participant's breath visible and follows it as air that passes between people, forests and oceans around the planet.
works.description_zh: 社交混合现实作品：让每位参与者的呼吸显形，并追随它作为空气在人、森林与海洋之间环绕地球流动。
works.idea_en: Your breath is not yours: becoming the air shows how every exhalation joins a planetary atmosphere.
works.idea_zh: 你的呼吸并不属于你：成为空气，看到每一次呼气都汇入地球的大气。
works.method: Breath sensing drives particle visualisations in a shared mixed-reality space (Magic Leap / VR headsets).
works.method_zh: 呼吸感测驱动共享混合现实空间中的粒子可视化（Magic Leap / VR 头显）。

works.title: Animalia Sum
works.description: A comic VR mockumentary about a future in which insects are humanity's main protein: the viewer becomes a bug, then a farmer milking bugs, and watches a boxing match between a bug and a whale.
works.description_zh: 一部喜剧 VR 伪纪录片，设想昆虫成为人类主要蛋白质来源的未来：观众先成为一只虫，再成为给虫挤奶的农夫，还观看虫与鲸的拳击赛。
works.idea_en: Humour as a way into insect bodies: switching roles between eater and eaten questions how we rank animals.
works.idea_zh: 以幽默进入昆虫的身体：在吃与被吃之间切换角色，质疑我们如何给动物排序。
works.method: Hand-sculpted miniatures captured with photogrammetry, animated with a Perception Neuron suit, delivered as interactive 360° on Oculus Go.
works.method_zh: 手工微缩雕塑经摄影测量采集，用 Perception Neuron 动捕服制作动画，在 Oculus Go 上以互动 360° 呈现。

works.title: Notes on Blindness: Into Darkness
works.description: A VR adaptation of theologian John Hull's audio diaries about losing his sight: the world appears only as faint blue shapes where sound comes from — rain, wind, voices.
works.description_zh: 改编自神学家 John Hull 失明后录音日记的 VR 作品：世界只在声音传来的地方显现为淡蓝色轮廓——雨、风、人声。
works.idea_en: A world built from sound instead of sight: rain on a garden 'gives a contour to everything'.
works.idea_zh: 一个由声音而非视觉构成的世界：落在花园里的雨“给一切勾出轮廓”。
works.method: Binaural audio with real-time rendering where geometry is revealed only by sound sources; gaze interaction on mobile and PC VR.
works.method_zh: 双耳音频结合实时渲染，几何只在声源处显现；在移动与 PC VR 上以视线交互。

works.title: Plastisapiens
works.description: A surreal interactive VR eco-fiction in which the participant embodies animals and altered humans whose bodies have absorbed plastic and become more fluid.
works.description_zh: 超现实的互动 VR 生态小说：参与者化身体内吸收了塑料、身体变得更加流动的动物与变异人类。
works.idea_en: Becoming a plastic-permeated body: embodiment used for speculative, feminist eco-fiction rather than empathy.
works.idea_zh: 成为被塑料渗透的身体：具身被用于思辨的女性主义生态小说，而不是同理心。
works.method: Real-time VR with body-tracked avatars that deform and merge; produced by the NFB and DPT.
works.method_zh: 实时 VR，身体追踪的化身会变形与融合；加拿大国家电影局与 DPT 出品。

works.title: Critical Distance
works.description: A mixed-reality encounter with Kiki, a five-year-old Southern Resident orca, and her pod in the Salish Sea, showing how the pod lives by sound and how ship noise disrupts it.
works.description_zh: 与萨利希海南方定居虎鲸 Kiki（五岁）及其族群相遇的混合现实体验，展示族群如何依靠声音生活、船舶噪声又如何干扰它们。
works.idea_en: Seeing echolocation as sound in space: the orcas' acoustic world becomes visible around your body.
works.idea_zh: 把回声定位看成空间中的声音：虎鲸的声学世界在你身边显形。
works.method: Holographic orcas on Microsoft HoloLens 2 with spatialised clicks and calls visualised as sound in space.
works.method_zh: 在 Microsoft HoloLens 2 上呈现全息虎鲸，空间化的咔嗒声与叫声被可视化为空间中的声音。
shown_at: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History

works.title: Honey Fungus
works.description: A series of embodied VR experiments set inside a queer, sentient fungal network, mixing AI-generated field-research poetry with actions that cultivate intimacy with ecology.
works.description_zh: 一系列具身 VR 实验，发生在一个酷儿的、有感知的真菌网络中，把 AI 生成的野外研究诗与培养生态亲密感的动作结合起来。
works.idea_en: Intimacy with fungi as a model for relating to ecology: the body is asked to touch, feed and entangle rather than observe.
works.idea_zh: 以与真菌的亲密作为与生态相处的模型：身体被要求去触碰、喂养与缠绕，而不是观看。
works.method: Four-headset VR installation with embodied hand interactions and AI-remixed text (Stevens Institute of Technology, Hybrid Studio).
works.method_zh: 四头显 VR 装置，具身手部交互与 AI 混编文本（Stevens 理工学院、Hybrid Studio）。

works.title: The Treachery of Sanctuary
works.description: A three-panel interactive installation in which visitors' shadows disintegrate into birds, are pecked apart by birds, and finally sprout giant wings that let them take flight.
works.description_zh: 三联屏互动装置：观众的影子先碎成飞鸟，再被鸟啄散，最后长出巨大的翅膀起飞。
works.idea_en: Birth, death and transfiguration as a bird: the participant's own silhouette turns into flight.
works.idea_zh: 以鸟完成诞生、死亡与变形：参与者自己的剪影化为飞行。
works.method: Kinect depth sensing and custom software project real-time silhouettes onto three large screens above a reflecting pool.
works.method_zh: Kinect 深度感测与定制软件把实时剪影投到反射水池上方的三块大屏。

works.title: PLANET ∞
works.description: A 360° organic tale set after human extinction: the viewer, at the scale of tiny organisms, sees fungi and mould growing among giant dried insect bodies until rain floods the planet and giant carnivorous tadpoles appear.
works.description_zh: 360° 有机寓言，设定在人类灭绝之后：观众处在微小生物的尺度，看见真菌与霉菌在巨大的干枯昆虫尸体间生长，直到雨水淹没星球、巨型食肉蝌蚪出现。
works.idea_en: A post-human planet seen at the scale of mould: macro time-lapse makes fungi and tadpoles the inhabitants of the world.
works.idea_zh: 以霉菌的尺度看一个后人类星球：微距延时让真菌与蝌蚪成为世界的居民。
works.method: Macro and time-lapse photography of real fungi, mould and tadpoles composited into stereoscopic 360° video with 3D audio (mk2 VR).
works.method_zh: 对真实真菌、霉菌与蝌蚪进行微距与延时拍摄，合成为立体 360° 影片并配 3D 音频（mk2 VR 出品）。

works.title: The World Beneath Our Feet
works.description: An in-the-round digital installation that transports visitors underground and zooms into soil to show the abundance of microscopic life inside it.
works.description_zh: 环形数字装置，把观众带到地下，不断放大土壤，展现其中丰富的微观生命。
works.idea_en: Soil as a living world to revere like a coral reef: descending to the scale of soil organisms.
works.idea_zh: 土壤是一个像珊瑚礁一样值得珍视的活世界：下沉到土壤生物的尺度。
works.method: Multi-screen surround projection of animated microscopic soil life, based on research for Monbiot's book Regenesis.
works.method_zh: 多屏环绕投影呈现土壤微观生命动画，基于 Monbiot 著作《Regenesis》的研究。

works.title: Queer Ecology
works.description: An interactive body-mapped installation in which visitors face two celestial beings made of twigs and plant growth that move with their bodies; the figures merge with the person next to them, grow, die and dissolve into pollen or star dust.
works.description_zh: 互动身体映射装置：访客面对两个由枝条与植物生长构成的天体般的存在，它们随访客的身体移动；这些形体会与旁边的人融合，生长、死亡，并消散为花粉或星尘。
works.idea_en: 'There is nothing more queer than nature': your mirrored body becomes a plant being that grows, decays and merges beyond binary identity.
works.idea_zh: “没有什么比自然更酷儿”：镜像中的身体成为会生长、衰败、与他人融合的植物存在，超越二元身份。
works.method: Real-time body tracking (with Target3D) mapped onto generative 3D plant-bodies on a large screen, with growth and decay cycles.
works.method_zh: 实时身体追踪（与 Target3D 合作）映射到大屏上的生成式三维植物身体，带有生长与衰败的循环。

works.title: Noise Aquarium
works.description: An immersive audio-visual installation of magnified 3D-scanned plankton in an underwater world; visitors are invited to make disruptive noise and watch its impact on the creatures.
works.description_zh: 沉浸式视听装置：放大的三维扫描浮游生物处在水下世界中；访客被邀请制造干扰性噪声，并看到它对这些生物的影响。
works.idea_en: Feeling noise pollution from the plankton's side: tiny drifters made huge and vulnerable to sound.
works.idea_zh: 从浮游生物一侧感受噪声污染：微小的漂流者被放大，在声音面前脆弱。
works.method: 3D scientific imaging of plankton on projection or dome displays with ocean noise recordings; visitor input (sound, and in some versions a balance board) disturbs the scene.
works.method_zh: 浮游生物的三维科学成像，以投影或穹顶呈现并配合海洋噪声录音；访客的输入（声音，部分版本还有平衡板）会扰动画面。

works.title: Refuge for Resurgence
works.description: A multispecies banquet table with seats, crockery and cutlery designed for fourteen species — from humans to wolf, rat, pigeon, moss and fungi — set in a post-flood home.
works.description_zh: 一张多物种宴会桌，为十四个物种——从人类到狼、老鼠、鸽子、苔藓与真菌——设计了座位、餐具与刀叉，置于洪水过后的家中。
works.idea_en: Taking a seat as one species among many: design that asks visitors to imagine the table from other animals' needs.
works.idea_zh: 作为众多物种之一入座：以设计邀请访客从其他动物的需要出发想象这张桌子。
works.method: Hand-carved wooden table and custom ceramic, glass and metal tableware for each species.
works.method_zh: 手工雕刻的木桌，以及为每个物种定制的陶瓷、玻璃与金属餐具。

works.title: Dolphin Embassy
works.description: A research project for a floating marine centre where humans and dolphins would meet and communicate on equal terms, documented in drawings, models and video.
works.description_zh: 一个为人与海豚平等相遇与交流而设计的漂浮海洋中心的研究计划，以图纸、模型与影像记录。
works.idea_en: An embassy between species: architecture designed to meet dolphins in their medium rather than in a tank.
works.idea_zh: 物种之间的大使馆：让建筑在海豚的介质中与它们相遇，而不是在水族箱里。
works.method: Speculative architecture with planned underwater listening and video systems; realised as drawings, models and expeditions (1974–78).
works.method_zh: 思辨建筑，构想了水下聆听与影像系统；以图纸、模型与考察（1974–78）呈现。

works.title: Sculpture for Octopuses: Exploring for Their Favorite Colors
works.description: Small glass balls in many colours made for octopuses, thrown into the sea from a fishing boat and later placed in a tank at Suma Aqualife Park, Kobe, so the artist could film which colours the animals chose.
works.description_zh: 为章鱼制作的多色小玻璃球，先从渔船上投入海中，后又放进神户须磨海洋世界的大水箱，艺术家拍下章鱼会选择哪些颜色。
works.idea_en: Art whose audience is an octopus: the work is completed by the animal's perception and choice.
works.idea_zh: 以章鱼为观众的艺术：作品由动物的感知与选择来完成。
works.method: Hand-made glass objects offered to octopuses, documented as a slideshow of their reactions.
works.method_zh: 为章鱼手工制作的玻璃物件，以幻灯片记录章鱼的反应。

works.title: Forest of Us
works.description: A mirrored walk-through installation whose branching forms reveal the likeness between the bronchial tree of human lungs and the branching of trees, with a soundscape of breath.
works.description_zh: 镜面步行装置，其分支形态揭示人类支气管树与树木枝杈之间的相似，并伴随呼吸声景。
works.idea_en: Breathing with trees: the lungs are shown as an inverted tree that completes the one outside.
works.idea_zh: 与树一起呼吸：肺被呈现为一棵倒置的树，与外面的树彼此补全。
works.method: Mirrored maze, projected light and spatial sound composed around breathing and photosynthesis.
works.method_zh: 镜面迷宫、投影光与围绕呼吸和光合作用创作的空间声音。
shown_at: Every Wall is a Door, Superblue Miami 2021

works.title: The Hive
works.description: A 17-metre aluminium lattice sculpture whose 1,000 LED lights and sound pulse in real time with the vibrations of a live honeybee colony; visitors can bite on a stick to hear the bees by bone conduction.
works.description_zh: 一座 17 米高的铝制格架雕塑，1000 盏 LED 灯与声音随一个活蜂群的振动实时脉动；访客可咬住小木棒，通过骨传导听见蜜蜂。
works.idea_en: Sensing a colony as one body: the hive's vibrations become light, sound and a signal felt through the skull.
works.idea_zh: 把蜂群当作一个身体来感知：蜂巢的振动变成光、声音，以及经由颅骨感受到的信号。
works.method: Accelerometers in a hive at Kew stream vibration data that drive LEDs and a composed soundscape; bone-conduction listening posts.
works.method_zh: 邱园蜂箱中的加速度计传出振动数据，驱动 LED 与作曲声景；设有骨传导聆听点。

leads.name: Texada (Josephine Anderson & Claire Sanford)
leads.why: IDFA DocLab 2023 VR doc contrasting human and geological time through a limestone quarry; no public trailer found.

leads.name: We Are Dead Animals (Tote Tiere Maarten)
leads.why: IDFA DocLab 2025 VR game: revive, eat and recombine photogrammetry-scanned dead animals; closer to mortality than becoming.

leads.name: The Oracle: Ritual for the Future (for humans and non-humans) (Victorine van Alphen)
leads.why: IDFA DocLab 2025 360° ritual where the audience is overtaken by non-human (AI) entities; machine field candidate.

leads.name: David Attenborough's Conquest of the Skies (Alchemy Immersive)
leads.why: Venice Immersive 2023 VR180 series on the evolution of flight; shows rather than embodies.

leads.name: Metamorphic (Sensorium: John Fitzgerald, Matthew Niederhauser, Wesley Allsbrook, Elie Zananiri)
leads.why: Sundance 2020 social VR of context-dependent, shape-shifting Quill bodies; not clearly non-human.

leads.name: Empathy Creatures
leads.why: Venice Immersive 2025 AI-driven virtual bird that senses visitors; encounter rather than embodiment.

leads.name: Birdly (Somniacs)
leads.why: Full-body red-kite flight simulator shown at Sundance New Frontier, SXSW, GIFF Tous Écrans 2014 and SIGGRAPH 2014 Emerging Technologies; left to animals/HCI batches — add to sundance-new-frontier when it exists.

leads.name: Pollinator Pathmaker: Perceptual Field (Alexandra Daisy Ginsberg)
leads.why: Design Museum More than Human 2025 tapestry of a garden from a pollinator's perception; add to design-museum-more-than-human-2025 when animals-art writes it.

leads.name: Marcus Coates, Nature Calendar
leads.why: Design Museum More than Human 2025; Coates' becoming-animal works (Dawn Chorus, Journey to the Lower World) belong to animals-art.

leads.name: Once a Glacier
leads.why: IDFA DocLab 2022 360° glacier piece with motion-capture dance and Indigenous poetry; visual only.

leads.name: Tónandi (Sigur Rós & Magic Leap Studios)
leads.why: Venice VR 2019 mixed-reality creatures that play music at your touch; interaction rather than embodiment.

leads.name: Future Botanica (Polymorf)
leads.why: IDFA DocLab / SXSW 2025 generative-AI plant ecosystems for future climates; design of plants, not becoming.

leads.name: Namoo (Erick Oh)
leads.why: Sundance 2021 animated VR in which a tree grows alongside one man's life; tree as metaphor.

leads.name: Solwata (Felix Gaedtke & Gayatri Parameswaran)
leads.why: Venice Immersive 2026 mixed reality on sea-level rise in the Solomon Islands; human community perspective, no nonhuman embodiment.

leads.name: Disneynature's Wolf: an immersive experience (Silverback Films)
leads.why: Venice Immersive 2026 Arctic wolf film; observational wildlife film.
